name: Specimen Lab
why: Three anatomy facts read best as a biologist's specimen sheet: labelled parts, counts and a lab stamp — one real octopus to prove it's real.
look: Cream lab paper with a faint grid, deep navy ink, one coral accent for whatever the voice names; labels are rounded tags, verdicts are stamps. The one footage shot stays in natural colour.
elements: giant headline with a coral marker
element tiles (Cu / Fe) like a periodic table
a drawn octopus whose brains light up
motion: Elements spring in on their word (snappy, one bounce for the hearts); hard cuts between shots.
